correctness.rationale: Exact hyperbolic angle and Gauss--Bonnet calculation yields area (1). Three-point order-statistic Jacobian yields independent beta(2,2) span and uniform internal ratio. Conditional integration derives the cdf. Dominated convergence and explicit beta endpoint singularities give Pareto coefficient 24 and moment threshold 1. An independent hyperbolic cosine-rule implementation confirms area at several positive gaps. Explicit split-integral asymptotics gives mean 24 log(L/2)-24, and a constant-density change of variables with Scheffe gives the marked TV limit; no infinite claim is based only on numeric trials.

value.rationale: Hyperbolic ideal area pi and finite horocycles are intrinsic canonical objects; the theorem gives a complete exact limit distribution with support threshold, sharp Pareto constant 24, critical moment cutoff, and a two-term finite-size expectation. Its marked geometric law explains that a single rare adjacent gap causes large scaled deficits, with an explicit beta span and uniform short-gap mark. These invariants reveal a non-uniform-integrability effect and geometry not supplied by the deterministic area formula or general random-ball limit.
